A '''Captain of the Air''' is an officer in the [[Seanchan]] army, and is in command of those who ride ''[[raken]]'' and ''[[to'raken]]''. The rank's sole use far indicates someone in command of all'' raken ''and ''to'raken'' in the return, it is unknown if there are any higher ranks pertaining to aerial units. Little else is known about them besides the rank except that certain rules forbid them flying very often.

==Known examples==
Abaldar Yulan was Captain of Air during the [[Dragon Reborn]] 's battle with the Seanchan at [[Ebou Dar]] .
